text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, but is this the place for<n>the Zen
meditation lesson?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Grass Wonder. You're most<n>welcome to join
us. Though there's<n>just one thing...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
My legs are gonna fall off... I-I can't<n>take take it
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
People tend to underestimate the<n>muscle cramps
one can get during<n>meditation. I've been
encouraging<n>everyone to start with shorter
sessions, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how interesting. In that case,<n>I'd like to try an
unlimited session.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I figured you would say that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In the darkness, you will confront<n>yourself. Learning
to clear your mind<n>will become an aid for you when
you<n>run.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(A clear mind, nothingness... A state<n>where all
nefarious elements have<n>left the body...)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Where is this? How did I get to the<n>track?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky charges ahead! A<n>"Beast" indeed!
Can anyone catch<n>up? Anyone at all?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, is there no one here to<n>challenge me? I
guess the top is<n>mine, thank you very much. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...No. Not yet!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: (A clear mind is still far out of my<n>reach.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(Especially when every inch of me<n>yearns to make
it to the top!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder! Grass Wonder is<n>closing in! Will it
be enough?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen such intense<n>concentration, Grass
Wonder. Did you<n>reach a state of nothingness?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...No. It seems I still need more time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However, I believe I managed to<n>reaffirm
something.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My goal. My one destination.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Perhaps this is the effect of<n>Zen meditation?
All distractions have<n>been cleared from my mind.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After that, Grass Wonder's<n>commitment to training
continues to<n>grow more intense.
